content:
FINAL REELS REMAINING WORK — EXECUTE NOW

The Home Reels size defect is fixed and deployed on SHA a3dbd881faea.

Do not re-audit completed items.
Do not change the Home card size again.
Continue only with the remaining PARTIAL and NOT TESTED items.

1. VERIFY CI

- Open GitHub Actions for SHA a3dbd881faea.
- Confirm every required job is green.
- Return workflow name, run ID, job names, timestamps and conclusion.
- If CI is not green, fix every failure, commit, rerun and deploy the new green SHA.

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

2. BUILD THE FINAL ANDROID APK

- Build a release APK from the exact current production source.
- Confirm package ID, version, versionCode and source SHA.
- Run APK structural validation.
- Publish it at a permanent owner-controlled URL.
- Return APK SHA-256 and file size.

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

3. RUN REAL ANDROID DEVICE QA

Install the final APK on a physical Android phone.

Test:

- Fresh install
- Owner login
- Home screen
- Home Reels card size
- Open selected Reel
- Full-screen vertical playback
- Swipe next and previous
- Pause and resume
- Mute and unmute
- Background and resume
- Return to Home
- Logout and login
- Restart application

Record screenshots and screen recording.

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

4. TEST REAL VIDEO UPLOAD

Upload from the Android device:

- 1080 × 1920 MP4
- 720 × 1280 MP4
- horizontal MP4
- video with audio
- video without audio
- rotated video
- large video
- unsupported video
- corrupted file

Verify:

- progress
- cancel
- retry
- no duplicate media
- poster creation
- correct orientation
- audio synchronization
- Admin visibility
- Home visibility
- Full Reels visibility
- Landing visibility
- property/deal association

Return media IDs and playback URLs.

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

5. COMPLETE VIDEO QUALITY QA

For real uploaded videos, measure:

- original resolution
- delivered resolution
- bitrate
- frame rate
- codec
- audio codec
- time to first frame
- buffering count
- dropped frames
- image sharpness
- orientation
- audio synchronization

Do not call it Instagram-quality without measured evidence.

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

6. IMPLEMENT AND VERIFY TRANSCODING

Current limitation:

- Android receives original MP4
- Web/iOS use HLS where available
- No server-side multi-rendition transcoding

Implement:

- 1080p rendition
- 720p rendition
- 540p or 480p rendition
- poster image
- thumbnail
- processing status
- retry on failure
- duplicate-processing prevention
- signed/private source handling
- MP4 fallback

Test one real uploaded video through the complete pipeline.

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

7. VERIFY ADAPTIVE PLAYBACK

Test rendition selection on:

- strong Wi-Fi
- normal 5G
- slow cellular
- high latency
- packet loss
- Wi-Fi to cellular
- cellular to Wi-Fi

Verify:

- quality changes appropriately
- no crash
- no infinite spinner
- playback recovers
- poster remains visible during recovery

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

8. RUN LONG-SESSION QA

Run:

- 15-minute session
- 30-minute session
- 100-Reel scroll
- 50 videos played
- 20 Home ↔ Reels transitions
- 10 background/resume cycles
- 20 comments opened
- 20 likes/unlikes
- 10 shares

Acceptance:

- 0 crashes
- 0 ANRs
- 0 audio overlaps
- 0 frozen players
- no uncontrolled memory growth
- no duplicate subscriptions
- no request storm

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

9. COMPLETE ACCESSIBILITY

Verify on device and web:

- TalkBack
- play/pause label
- mute label
- like/comment/share labels
- focus order
- minimum touch targets
- reduced motion
- captions support
- keyboard navigation
- visible focus
- no navigation trap

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

10. FIX LIKE ENGAGEMENT FIELD

The UI currently offers “Fix like engagement field.”

Audit and verify:

- viewer/member ID mapping
- like record schema
- duplicate-like prevention
- unlike behavior
- optimistic rollback
- count reconciliation
- owner moderation
- anonymous behavior
- unauthorized request rejection

Add regression tests and deploy.

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

11. VALIDATE ADMIN REELS

The UI currently offers “Validate admin.”

Test live:

- add Reel
- edit Reel
- replace video
- replace poster
- reorder
- feature
- hide
- show
- link property/deal
- delete
- refresh
- cache invalidation
- sync to Home
- sync to Reels
- sync to Landing

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

12. FINAL DEPLOYMENT AND PARITY

After all fixes:

GitHub HEAD
=
CI SHA

Render worker SHA
=
/version SHA
=
APK source SHA

Return:

- final commit SHA
- CI run ID
- Render deploy ID
- production SHA
- boot time
- APK version
- APK versionCode
- APK SHA-256
- permanent APK URL
